items.title: Summarize all local review verdict runs in autopilot_review_status
items.context: Add an explicit all-runs/latest-runs view or equivalent summary so operators are not misled by the default-run view after submitting custom round ids. Preserve current runId-specific behavior and local non-Authority semantics.

items.title: Show voluntary local 3x2 rounds in review_escalation_status
items.context: When review escalation is not required, the command should still expose submitted local host verdict rounds for operator visibility without changing ok/required semantics or claiming Authority completion.

items.title: Render a concise stale-material DONE runbook
items.context: When DONE pre-check detects stale verification evidence or stale host verdicts after a main merge/materialHash change, surface which evidence/verdicts are stale and the next commands to recover, including validate, refresh stale evidence, and re-submit host verdicts over the current material hash.

items.title: Add focused regression coverage and docs for the diagnostic UX
items.context: Add smoke coverage for all-runs/latest-runs status, voluntary 3x2 display, and stale-material runbook wording. Update docs to distinguish local review assurance diagnostics from Authority/production receipt claims.
